comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego initiates by turning onto the trafficway occupied by responder agent1. Chosen assumptions: ego enters the outer lane of a multilane receiving road by turning right. Agent1 approaches straight in that same outer lane, then changes to the same-direction lane on its left after ego enters its path and the target lane is clear. Left-adjacent lanes are required on the initial approaches and receiving road; the actual evasion is gated until agent1 reaches the receiving road. Speeds, initial distances, a nominal entry-time gap, and any response delay are chosen assumptions; no collision outcome is required.
